full_details.title: Beckhoff PLC Oven Control Code
full_details.full_description:
I need code development for a Beckhoff PLC to control an oven. The primary functionality required is temperature monitoring and recording.

Key requirements:
- Develop PLC program for oven temperature monitoring through visualizing the reading for 44 thermocouples on the HMI and recording the data every (15 seconds)
- data recorded should include date-time of the patch start (patch start will be recognized through one digital input)
- alarm to be raised through HMI if memory going to be full

Ideal skills and experience:
- Proficiency in Beckhoff PLC programming 
- Knowledge of temperature sensors and data logging

Looking for a freelancer who can deliver accurate and reliable control code.
